title: Animate
description: Plays one of the library's keyframe animations on its host, when it is clicked or as soon as it loads. A button always plays it on click. It applies to any element, so it names no host.

animation.description: The keyframe to play, by name: fade-in, fade-out, slide-in, zoom-in, bounce, shake, pulse, flip, rotate and the rest of effects.css's x-* keyframes.

duration.description: How long one play lasts (any CSS time).

trigger.description: click plays it on each click; load plays it once when the behavior attaches. A button always uses click.
trigger.visualReason: Chooses when the animation plays, not how it looks.

setup: Fades in on load

_metadata.derivedFrom: src/wb-viewmodels/effects.js animate() — every property here is one the behavior reads and uses; delay is read but never applied, so it is not declared
